sub_answers.sub_question: In what ways did Randy Johnson contribute to team win totals, division titles, or postseason appearances during his tenure?
sub_answers.text: Johnson led the Arizona Diamondbacks to the playoffs in 1999 while posting a 17–9 record, a 2.48 ERA and 364 strikeouts that season [d386384s9p0]. Johnson produced high-win seasons that directly increased team win totals, including 19 wins in 2000 and a 24–5 season in 2002 [d386384s9p0][d386384s11p0]. Johnson and Curt Schilling together anchored the Diamondbacks rotation, providing a two-ace core that supported postseason contention [d386384s9p0]. Johnson’s dominant stretches with the Mariners (for example a 20–4 1997 season and a 53–9 run between 1994–1997) also contributed substantially to team success during those years [d386384s7p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: What team pitching records or franchise milestones were set or approached while Randy Johnson was on those rosters?
sub_answers.text: Johnson extended and set MLB pitching milestones by recording multiple consecutive 300-strikeout seasons, establishing a record for the most consecutive 300+ strikeout seasons [d386384s11p0]. Johnson won multiple Cy Young Awards in both leagues and led the majors in innings, complete games and strikeouts in 1999, marking franchise-leading pitching performances [d386384s9p0]. In 2002 Johnson won the pitching Triple Crown (leading the NL in wins, ERA and strikeouts) and became the first pitcher in baseball history to post a 24–5 record [d386384s11p0].

sub_answers.text: Opposing players sometimes avoided facing Johnson altogether, as exemplified by Larry Walker choosing not to play when scheduled to face him and expressing real concern about facing Johnson’s velocity [d386384s7p0]. Teammates and catchers credited Johnson’s intensity and ‘stuff’ with elevating catcher performance and game preparation, implying his strikeout ability changed in-game dynamics for both teams [d28263789s3p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: What pitches composed Randy Johnson's repertoire and which was considered his most effective strikeout pitch?
